The institute announced today the appointment of Dr. Maria Alvarez as its new scientific director, effective January 1. Dr. Alvarez, a pediatric neurologist, has led the clinical research program for the past eight years, where she directed studies on childhood epilepsy and neurodevelopmental disorders. She will oversee the institute's intramural research portfolio, including laboratories in genetics, imaging, and behavioral science. "Dr. Alvarez brings both scientific vision and a deep commitment to patients and families," said the institute director. "Her leadership will help us pursue the most promising opportunities in developmental medicine." Before joining the institute, Dr. Alvarez held faculty positions at two major universities and trained at a leading children's hospital. She has authored more than 120 peer-reviewed publications and received several awards for clinical teaching.
